mismatches: The screw access channels (rectangular cutouts) are visible on the side of the spine, but they do not appear to extend through the entire width/depth as required for screwdriver access from the front.
The design document specifies a tapered profile for the arm to reduce mass, but the rendered part shows an arm with a constant width along its entire length.
summary: The part follows the general L-shape geometry and dimensions, but fails to implement the specified tapering of the shelf arm and the screwdriver access channels are not clearly executed as described.
